How may I apply for admission?
Applicants for any graduate program at TSU must complete and submit their application online. Any application materials not submitted online need to be forwarded to:
The Graduate School
Texas Southern University
TSU Box #1254
3100 Cleburne Avenue Houston, Texas 77004
Application Checklist?
While there are several common elements for a graduate program application, at the
graduate level, programs may vary in application requirements. When you initiate an
application via the application portal and select a program you will be prompted to
provide the application materials for that program.
A general checklist follows:
Application for Admission
Apply online here
Official Transcripts
Essay/Statement of Purpose
Professional Resume
Letters of Recommendation
GRE Scores (or GMAT Scores for business programs) - if required by the Program
TOEFL / IELTS Scores – for International Applicants Only
$50/- Non-Refundable Application Fee ($75/- For International Applicants), payable
To Texas Southern University
How will I know that I have been accepted?
Once you have been accepted to the program you applied for, you will receive an acceptance
letter via email and via the application portal.
What is a T-Number and how can I find my T-Number?
Each admitted student is issued a Texas Southern University ID number commonly referred
to as a T-Number. The T-number will be provided on the admission letter. Please safeguard
your T-Number as it is a unique identifying number for you. Once you have the T-Number,
please include it on all correspondence with the University.
What Graduate Degree programs are offered at TSU?
Click here to access a list of graduate degrees programs offered at TSU.
Application Submission Deadlines
At the Graduate level, some programs offer admission during Fall, Spring, and the
Summer semester; some programs only accept new students for Fall and Spring; some
programs, especially at the Doctoral level, only accept students during the Fall semester. Click here for a list of programs with application deadlines for the respective semesters that applicants can apply for.
GRE or GMAT Requirement
Applicants for all Doctoral programs at TSU must submit official GRE Scores as part of their application. At the Masters level programs
vary in their respective requirements.
Click here for a list of programs with GRE requirement as noted.
For programs requiring the GRE (or GMAT for business programs) applicants must submit
official scores as part of their application.
Texas Southern University Institutional Code for GRE/GMAT: 6824
International Applicants
Evaluated Transcripts:
International applicants from most countries must submit an evaluated transcript evaluated
by a TSU approved transcript evaluation service provider.
Click on the following link for a list of TSU approved Transcript Evaluation Service
Providers:
http://www.tsu.edu/admissions/international/
TOEFL or IELTS Scores:
International applicants also need to submit official TOEFL (Test of English as a
Foreign Language) score if the applicant’s native language is not English, unless
the applicant has received an undergraduate degree from a U.S. college or university.
A TOEFL score of at least 550 on the paper based test or 213 on the computer based
test or 79 on the Internet based test is required. An official IELTS score can be
submitted in lieu of TOEFL in which case a minimum overall band score of 6.0 is required.
Texas Southern University Institutional Code for TOEFL: 6824
For IELTS select Texas Southern University
For additional questions and/or information regarding other international issues such
as submission of a financial guarantee, I-20, etc. please review the FAQ section for International Admission.
Where is the Graduate School located?
The Graduate School is located on Level 2 (Suite 201) of Hannah Hall which is the
main administration building at Texas Southern University (HH 201).
